pages.text:
[[bronze_armor|Bronze armor]] remade at the [[apothecary_altar]]. As strong as netherite, and as fireproof. Repair with [[lonsdaleite_shard|shards]]. Enchantments and trims carry over.

It's banded like the [[reinforced_trim]] and shimmers red, even when enchanted. It still takes a trim.

Each piece has its own power:

**Helmet:** night vision.
**Chestplate:** piglins stay neutral, as with gold.
**Leggings:** walk up one-block steps.
**Boots:** speed, the same as Speed I.
